caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object, rendered in shades of gray and black, positioned diagonally across a cream-colored background. The primary object appears to be composed of angular, geometric sections at the top, with one end forming a pointed or spout-like projection. Below the main body, there are two symmetrically arranged, curved extensions ending in looped or ring-like forms, connected by hinge-jointed segments to the main body. Below the central illustration, there is a smaller, simpler schematic in fine lines showing the same object in front and side elevation, with a vertical measurement indicated as “6 1/2.” The image is framed by a thin rectangular border, and the lower right corner contains the name “Erwin Schwabe” in small lettering. The entire drawing is monochromatic, utilizing only shades of gray, black, and the natural beige color of the paper.
title: Candle Snuffer
